comment: Exceptions to the helix-lint preset (#159). Every entry needs `files` (file paths, no globs), `rules` and a `reason`; helixAllow throws without one and so fails `pnpm lint`. One entry per file and rule. Stylelint rules and `helix/no-raw-control` are listed under their own key.

stylelint.reason: The log viewer is a dark surface in light and dark theme with an ANSI palette per color class; Helix has no tokens for it (docs/STYLEGUIDE.md, Deviations)
The stderr line background is a translucent tint of the literal stderr red on the dark log surface; a Helix token would change with the theme
The terminal is a dark surface in light and dark theme (xterm theme set in TypeScript); Helix has no token for it (docs/STYLEGUIDE.md, Deviations)
